reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a Mirror Trading International referral-based business by urging viewers to build a team, recruit people who fund accounts, and sign up through a referral link in pursuit of financial freedom. It also directs referrers to obtain members' contact details and help them fund accounts, establishing a concrete recruitment and money-flow mechanism. Although it does not state a specific guaranteed return, the records do not establish actual returns, losses, consent to contact, or completed transactions.

citations.quote: if you are giving out your referral link this means you intend to build a team
If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin
Assist them with funding their account
you can guide them in building a team of their own

opening.argument: Judge the financial language by what it actually promises. The speaker calls this an "opportunity," not a guaranteed result, and asks referrers to answer questions and provide information when needed. The presentation does not give a return figure or promise that funding an account will produce a particular payout. Its opening slide says the video will help viewers grow a business; that is promotional language, but it is not a guarantee of investment returns. The narrower reading is guidance for people already managing referrals, with questions and assistance left open.

citations.quote: this is your opportunity to build a business
answer any questions they may have and forward any information they need

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies referrals, account funding and a team tree, but those observations do not establish a promised return or a payment to the referrer when someone funds an account. The speaker also tells referrers to ask whether people need assistance and to answer their questions. Calling that process a money-flow mechanism goes further than the cited words: the video describes help with funding, not a completed transfer or its outcome.

citations.quote: ask them if they need assistance with anything
Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a fixed return does not make this a neutral discussion of risk. The speaker directs referrers to build a team, follow up with people who have not funded their accounts, and help them fund those accounts. The closing pitch links building that business to financial freedom. Questions and assistance are presented within a recruitment process, not as a warning against joining.

citations.quote: if you are giving out your referral link this means you intend to build a team
If they have joined and not yet funded their account
the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom

opening.argument: This is addressed to people who already have referrals: it explains how to find a detailed report, identify contact information and use existing tutorials. The speaker even poses the operational question of what to do when team members are unfamiliar. The account and team screens serve as demonstrations of those steps. That focus matters: the presentation spends its time explaining how to support existing members, rather than showing a return calculation or instructing the audience to send money to the speaker.

citations.quote: I have people in my team whom I don't know what should I do?
go to Direct referrals and click on See Detailed Report
Tell them about the video channel and ask them if they need assistance with anything.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's quotes show what members are taught to do, but their instructional setting matters. The report and genealogy display explain how to locate people already in a team; they do not, by themselves, show what anyone earned. The funding passage is phrased as assistance for someone who has already joined, while the video also directs members to tutorials and answers to questions.

citations.quote: when someone joins using your referral link
Remember to tell them about the video channel so they can get more information.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructions are not detached education about a platform. They tell viewers that distributing a referral link means intending to build a team, to follow up when a referred person has not funded an account, and to help that person fund it. The speaker then proposes guiding recruits to build teams of their own. The tutorial format teaches a recruitment workflow; it does not remove the promotional purpose.

citations.quote: if you are giving out your referral link this means you intend to build a team
Assist them with funding their account
you can guide them in building a team of their own

opening.argument: A referral link and a team list do not alone establish a fraudulent payout scheme. The speaker describes contacting people who used a link, welcoming them, offering updates and helping with questions. The visible direct-referrals report shows a way to manage those contacts. What is missing from the presentation is a commission rate, a promised downline payment, or evidence that someone actually received one. Even the funding instruction concerns the referred person's own account. On this record, ordinary referral promotion remains a plausible reading.

citations.quote: welcome them to your business and ask them if they would like to be included into the WhatsApp group so they can get regular updates.
Assist them with funding their account

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution reasonably notes a structured team and funding guidance, but neither its quoted lines nor the tree supplies a commission formula or demonstrates a payment flowing up that tree. The instruction to obtain contact details is tied to welcoming people who joined through the speaker's link. Those details can support follow-up; their presence alone does not prove a deceptive financial transaction.

citations.quote: You will see a list of all the people who have joined using your referral link, you will find their email addresses listed, and their mobile number.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A commission formula is not necessary to recognize what the video promotes. It explicitly connects sharing a referral link with building a team, directs referrers to help recruits fund accounts, and encourages those recruits to build teams of their own. Its promise of a path to financial freedom gives that chain a financial pitch. The missing payout details limit what can be concluded about exact earnings, but do not turn the pitch into a routine loyalty offer.
